Alex / Emma —

Thanks again for the demo and the call today. Quick recap and the commitments we discussed so your procurement/legal team has a single note to reference: 

- Ask from AcmeFin: Do not use any AcmeFin customer data (including API payloads, file uploads, chat transcripts, and attachments) to improve or train Redwood models.
- Redwood response: We will enforce a training-on-customer-data opt-out at the tenant level. Data ingested under your account will not be used to train Redwood models or to improve model weights.
- Audit & controls: We will:
  - Apply the opt-out tagging at ingestion and block dataset copy to training stores.
  - Maintain request and operational logs for troubleshooting (retention details below).
  - Offer PII redaction guidance and attest to our redaction process on request.
- Retention & logs: Default request logging retained for 90 days; configurable retention can be discussed if you have longer archival requirements.
- Data residency: You asked for US-only residency — current deployment will be the US region; we will note this on the DPA and in the account config.

Next steps (agreed):
1) I will send a written opt-out confirmation and attach our standard DPA with the opt-out clause filled (attached).
2) You will share any additional procurement/PO requirements and the contact for Legal Ops (copy Emma if helpful).
3) Marissa from CS will follow up on technical validation steps for egress and logging.

Attachments included: DPA-AcmeFin.pdf, SOC2 summary (soc2-report-2026.pdf).

If that matches your notes, reply with a quick confirmation and we will route the signed DPA via DocuSign.

Thanks —
